Class GuiView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.View.View
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.View.GUI.GuiView
public class GuiView extends View
Owner of the JavaFX primary stage and of the per-session network objects (ServerConnection + ClientController). Acts as the single entry point that screen controllers use to access network/state.

Threading: every scene switch is wrapped in Platform.runLater(Runnable); the same applies to showError(String, String) which is safe to call from any thread.

    • endSession

      public void endSession()
      Ends the current network session and frees its resources: stops the client controller (removing its ViewListener and network pump), closes the connection, and drops any leftover server messages. Idempotent and safe to call when no session is active. Used by the "back to start" / "leave match" paths so a later reconnection starts from a clean state with a single active listener.

    • shutdownAndExit

      public void shutdownAndExit()
      Tears down the session and terminates the JVM. Stops the network pump and calls ServerConnection.disconnect(), which logs out from the server (so the player is marked DISCONNECTED) and unexports the RMI callback. System.exit(int) is required because RMI keeps non-daemon threads alive, so Platform.exit() alone would leave the process running headless.
